payoff: AI Financial Coach in Your Pocket
shortDescription: BudgetGPT is your AI-powered financial coach designed to simplify personal budgeting. It helps users build personalized budget plans, track spending, and receive expert financial guidance through conversational AI. Ideal for individuals who struggle with traditional budgeting methods, BudgetGPT offers a user-friendly alternative that connects to your financial accounts, providing categorized insights and a comprehensive dashboard for a clearer financial overview.
